Moved out of Uses: hydrolysing esculin, gelatin, starch or urea is an enzymatic phenotype, not substrate use. Substrates are mapped onto their enzyme activity where a standard one exists (gelatin->gelatinase, starch->amylase, urea->urease, arginine->arginine dihydrolase, tween->tween esterase), so they merge with the existing Enzyme sets.
